source_instruction: i am looking for a women's socks made up of polyester cotton which is washable in machine. also choose black or semi mint rush green color.
query: I passed the community garden on my walk this morning and stopped to chat with the retired lady who tends the plot right by the sidewalk. She showed me the weirdly bumpy heirloom tomatoes she’s been growing this year, all striped deep red and gold, and said the three stray cats that hang around the garden have been napping on the straw mulch around her pepper plants every afternoon this week. I even spotted one of them curled up on the edge of her raised bed, half-asleep with its paws tucked under its chin, while a bumblebee bumbled around the nearby basil plants. I’ve heard women’s socks and hosiery made of that polyester cotton blend exist, y’know? I’ve heard they come in that one, the usual color options I always grab. I’ve also heard of that thing I always need for my clothes so I don’t have to mess around with hand washing, and I’ve heard the total for those comes to no more than 30 bucks.
